reason: The current code already implements 16-negative sampled-softmax with shape-generic SASRec scoring, so the controlled 64-negative experiment requires sampler changes and updated training checks, without architectural changes. Broader negative competition is a plausible limitation, but macro validation HR@10 of 0.6062 and Electronics HR@10 of 0.455 do not establish it as the bottleneck. Similar SASRec experiments support testing this direction, while failed ensemble and AttentiveSimilarity trials favor preserving ResidualVAE, fusion, and all other training settings.

plan.data_processing_and_feature_engineering: In sample_sas_negatives(pos, indices, seen, n, rng), change neg allocation from pos.shape + (16,) to pos.shape + (64,) and draws from (len(columns), 16) to (len(columns), 64). Preserve independent uniform sampling with replacement, duplicate allowance, rejection against seen[idx] containing the complete training history, and zero-filled padded positions; this isolates broader negative coverage as the experimental change. Keep the function signature, variable names pos, indices, seen, n, rng, neg, columns, excluded, draws, and invalid, return type, eligible-history guard, sequence construction, and chronological truncation unchanged. Retain read_split, load_data, pack_history, supplied train/validation splits, preprocessing seed 0, all four DATASETS, and DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], without incorporating validation interactions into training.
plan.training_evaluation: Update check_sampled_softmax() to assert negative shapes (2, 3, 64) and (3, 64), verify 65 candidate logits against its independent cross-entropy reference, and retain padding, complete-history exclusion, finite-loss, and finite-gradient checks using isolated RNG state. Keep train_sas(ds, train, n, cases, device, deadline), its existing shape-generic active-position scoring, and temperature-one cross-entropy unchanged: each positive will now compete against 64 negatives, with uniform averaging over active positions and no sampling correction or auxiliary loss. Preserve both architectures, initialization, train_vae, optimizers, learning rates, dropout, batch size, BATCHES, EPOCHS environment default 200, clipping, validation cadence, lexicographic HR@10/NDCG@10 checkpoint selection, stale-counter stopping, runtime allocations, deadlines, and training seed 42; measure completed updates and elapsed time in existing SASRec logs because larger negative tensors increase cost. Preserve Predictor, expert_scores, ranks, equal-weight reciprocal-rank fusion with constant 60, checkpoint configurations, write_predict_script(), predict(user_id, history, candidates, *, dataset_name=None), strict checkpoint loading, and generated-predictor parity checks across all four routes, since inference is unchanged. Assess the isolated change against measured macro HR@10 0.6062 through independent pinned host validation with 200 users/category, 99 unique negatives, and evaluation seed 42, treating the proposed 0.005–0.015 gain as unverified while retaining trial-local artifacts, single-GPU execution, the shared 43,200 GPU-second budget, and host-only held-out evaluation.
